description: Blazor project and item templates that include Telerik UI for Blazor
releaseNotes:
New:
      * Added a Max SignalR Message Size setting.
      * Added a Max Form Body Length setting.
      * Added a Max Kestrel Request Body Size setting.
      * Added all template parameters to the .NET 6 project templates.

      Fixes:
      * Added a k-body CSS class to the HTML body element to apply text color and background color, depending on the Telerik theme.
      * Enabled unique project GUID generation for every new app.
      * Changed the project template names to better distinguish the legacy .NET 6-7 ones.
      * Improved the template parameter descriptions.
title: Telerik Blazor Project and Item Templates
